workflow_runs.name: Build and Push Docker Images
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: bake NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL at build time for production API URL

head_commit.message:
fix: bake NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL at build time for production API URL

- Add ARG/ENV to web and admin Dockerfiles for NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
- Pass NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL as build arg in build-images.yml and docker-compose.prod.yml
- Update backend CORS to support comma-separated FRONTEND_URL origins
- Auto-set FRONTEND_URL, VPS_HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL in deploy workflow
